variants.headline: Looking back: government cannot pay its debts
variants.sub: The colony's government is unable to pay its debts.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The government of {colony} cannot pay its debts.

Public finance is political because obligations are made and honoured in the name of a common undertaking. Our principles require more than a clever explanation of a failure to pay. They require an argument about responsibility that does not lose the people of the colony behind the language of debt.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We support {target} against an indiscriminate verdict. The failure to pay is serious, but it does not establish every accusation about its origins or prove that an imagined alternative would have performed better.
